source: MLBB Plus local data. Hero IDs official (Miya=1 ... Hirara=133). Image files use YOUR naming: lowercase, no spaces/dashes/apostrophe/dot. Example: Sora -> heroes/sora.webp, Popol and Kupa -> heroes/popolandkupa.webp, Chang'e -> heroes/change.webp, Luo Yi -> heroes/luoyi.webp, Yu Zhong -> heroes/yuzhong.webp. AssetManager path: heroes/{clean}.webp, load as file:///android_asset/heroes/{clean}.webp

schema.id: Official Moonton hero ID, stable across patches. Use this as primary key, NOT name.
schema.name: Display name
schema.role: Primary role: Tank / Fighter / Assassin / Mage / Marksman / Support
schema.lane: Best lane: Gold Lane / Mid Lane / EXP Lane / Jungle / Roam
schema.tier: S / A / B — current meta tier in patch 2.2.23
schema.coreItems: List of item IDs from items.json
schema.counters/counteredBy/synergies: Lists of hero IDs from this file
schema.image: AssetManager path, relative to src/main/assets/. Your webp filenames: lowercase, remove spaces, -, ', . — e.g. popolandkupa.webp, luoyi.webp, yuzhong.webp, change.webp. Load as file:///android_asset/heroes/{clean}.webp

heroes.name: Tigreal
heroes.title: Warrior of Dawn

skills.name: Fearless
skills.description: Gains Physical and Magic Defense when hit by basic attacks.

skills.name: Attack Wave
skills.description: Sends a shockwave that damages and slows enemies.

skills.name: Sacred Hammer
skills.description: Charges and slams, knocking enemies airborne.

skills.name: Implosion
skills.description: Blinks and pulls all nearby enemies to him, stunning them.

heroes.countersReason: Best engage tank. Loses to anti-CC and high mobility.
heroes.lore: The leader of the Light's Order, sworn to protect the Moniyan Empire.

heroes.name: Estes
heroes.title: Moon Elf King

skills.name: Moon Elf
skills.description: Heals himself and nearby allies over time.

skills.name: Moonlight Immersion
skills.description: Heals a target ally and enhances their next basic attack.

skills.name: Domain of Moon Goddess
skills.description: Creates a domain that slows enemies and heals allies inside.

skills.name: Blessing of Moon Goddess
skills.description: Heals all allies over time and removes crowd control.

heroes.lore: King of the Moon Elves who heals his allies with the power of the Moonlight.

heroes.name: Hanabi
heroes.title: Scarlet Flower

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Petal Barrage
skills.description: Basic attacks bounce to nearby enemies and mark them. Marked enemies take extra damage from Hanabi's skills.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Petal Barrage
skills.description: Enhances basic attacks to bounce and gain lifesteal. Toggle skill.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Soul Scroll
skills.description: Throws a scroll that damages and slows enemies in a line, restoring mana on hit.

skills.name: Forbidden Jutsu: Higanbana
skills.description: Throws a Higanbana that blooms on hit, immobilizing and bouncing to nearby enemies.

heroes.countersReason: Hanabi beats immobile mages and slow fighters she can kite. She loses to dive assassins and hard engage tanks.
heroes.lore: A young ninja of the Scarlet Sect who carries the weight of her clan. Her Higanbana blooms where enemies fall.

heroes.name: Khufra
heroes.title: Desert Tyrant

skills.name: Spell Curse
skills.description: Every 4th basic attack heals and enhances next skill.

skills.name: Tyrant's Revenge
skills.description: Dashes and knocks enemies airborne on landing.

skills.name: Bouncing Ball
skills.description: Turns into a ball that blocks dashes and knocks up enemies.

skills.name: Tyrant's Rage
skills.description: Pulls all nearby enemies to him and stuns them.

heroes.countersReason: Hard counters dash heroes like Fanny, Ling, Hayabusa.
heroes.lore: The tyrant of the Western Desert who feeds on the fear of his enemies.

heroes.name: Popol and Kupa
heroes.title: Brave Companions

skills.name: We Are Friends
skills.description: Kupa fights alongside Popol. When Kupa falls, Popol can revive him.

skills.name: Bite 'Em, Kupa!
skills.description: Commands Kupa to bite and slow an enemy.

skills.name: Kupa, Help!
skills.description: Throws a trap that stuns and reveals enemies.

skills.name: Popol's Surprise
skills.description: Popol rides Kupa, gaining movement speed and enhanced attacks.

heroes.countersReason: Revamped in 2.2.23 — ride mechanic gives chase/escape. Still weak to hard CC.
heroes.lore: Popol and his wolf Kupa, inseparable partners. In Patch 2.2.23 Popol can now ride Kupa to chase or escape.
